$comment: Release trees the fault suite rolls back to besides release N (release_tree.release_ref, the newest replay corpus). R-29 promises that a rollback reaches the release before this build (N-1) and nothing older, so a rollback scenario runs on `previous`: a tree that postdates every feature its scenario exercises. A rollback onto a tree from before a feature is kept only as an expected refusal (WORKER_INCOMPATIBLE, typed, no data touched). (FUPERF-FU-1). Move `previous` forward at each release; `postdates` names the features it must hold and the last tree without each, which integration-tests/unit/test_release_tree.py checks against git.
